methodologyNotes: Pricing was re-verified by fetching each vendor's official pricing page (buildium.com/pricing, doorloop.com/pricing, rentredi.com/pricing, hemlane.com/pricing, rentecdirect.com/pricing, propertyware.com/pricing, yardibreeze.com/pricing, avail.com/pricing) on 2026-06-15. Corrections applied: Rentec Direct base prices were wrong in the draft and were fixed to the live page ($55 Pro, $65 PM). AppFolio publishes no per-unit prices and directs visitors to request a quote, so all AppFolio monthlyUsd values are null (a null beats a guess; third-party per-unit estimates are noted but not used as confirmed prices). TurboTenant's pricing page returns HTTP 403; the free-forever tier and the $149/yr ($12.42/mo) Premium entry price were corroborated via TurboTenant's official Premium page/announcement and support center, with the clarification that Premium now scales by unit count (Essentials $149–$349/yr, Pro $199–$999/yr) rather than being a single flat plan. Yardi Breeze and Propertyware use per-unit pricing with monthly minimums and no single flat monthly fee, so their monthlyUsd values are null with per-unit rates and minimums recorded in notes. All prices are USD, monthly basis; where only an annual total was published the monthly equivalent is shown. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Buildium
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched directly from buildium.com/pricing on 2026-06-15. Plans are flat monthly fees that scale with unit count; Essential supports up to 150 units, Growth and Premium scale higher. Portfolios over 5,000 units require a call (877-396-7876).

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Starting at $62/month (scales with unit count); up to 150 units; core accounting, maintenance, leasing, basic communications and AI assistant, standard reporting. eSignatures $5/doc, bank account setup $99/account, property inspections $99 setup, EFT fees apply.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Starting at $192/month (scales with unit count); everything in Essential plus reporting automation, AI-enhanced communications, business analytics, enhanced tenant screening, reduced eSignature costs ($1/doc), 10 free bank accounts.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Starting at $400/month (scales with unit count); everything in Growth plus Open API, free property inspections, unlimited eSignatures, free first-year incoming EFT transactions (then $0.60/txn), 100 free bank accounts, full AI and automations suite, priority support.

limits: Over 5,000 units requires a call for pricing
keyFeatures: Full property accounting and trust accounting
AI-assisted communications and analytics
Open API on Premium tier
Built-in tenant screening and online rent collection
bestFor: property management companies needing full accounting
enrichment.provenance: Features and trial info fetched from buildium.com/pricing on 2026-06-15; 14-day free trial, no credit card required, confirmed on page.

vendors.name: AppFolio Property Manager
vendors.provenance: Fetched appfolio.com/pricing on 2026-06-15; the page publishes no specific per-unit rates and directs visitors to 'Get a Quote'. Each tier states a minimum spend and unit minimum (Core: 50-unit minimum). Per-unit estimates from third-party aggregators are noted but treated as unverified; monthlyUsd is null on all plans because no price is confirmed on the official page (a null beats a guess).

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Per-unit/month pricing (no public rate); 50-unit minimum and minimum monthly spend required per official page. Third-party sources estimate ~$1.40–$1.49/unit/month with ~$280–$298/mo minimum — UNVERIFIED, not on official page. Includes accounting, marketing/leasing, work orders, inspections, communications, standard integrations.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Per-unit/month pricing (no public rate); minimum spend and unit minimum apply per official page. Third-party sources estimate ~$3.00–$3.20/unit/month — UNVERIFIED. Adds affordable/student housing, advanced budgeting, data analysis, custom fields, read-only API.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: Per-unit/month pricing (no public rate); minimum spend and unit minimum apply per official page. Third-party sources estimate ~$5.00/unit/month with ~$7,500/mo minimum — UNVERIFIED. Adds leasing CRM, leasing signals, read/write API, dedicated customer success.

limits: minimum monthly spend on all plans
No per-unit pricing published — quote required
keyFeatures: AI-powered leasing and maintenance automation
Full property accounting with owner portals
Leasing CRM and signals on Max tier
Single platform for residential, commercial, student, affordable housing
bestFor: companies managing 50+ units needing enterprise features
enrichment.provenance: Features fetched from appfolio.com/pricing on 2026-06-15; pricing not publicly disclosed (quote-only).

vendors.name: DoorLoop
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched directly from doorloop.com/pricing on 2026-06-15. Plans show a $3/unit label with flat monthly minimums; Starter is capped at 10 units; portfolios over 300 units require a custom demo. A '30% off for 3 months' promo banner was active but the base list prices below are the standard rates. Aggregators show lower legacy monthly figures; deferred to live official page.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $99/month billed monthly or $69/month billed annually (save ~30%). Capped at 10 units. Includes rent collection, tenant portal, maintenance, text communications, accounting, rental applications with screening, lease management, basic support. No phone/Zoom support.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $189/month billed monthly or $149/month billed annually (~21% off). Unlimited units. Adds AI capabilities, QuickBooks integration, bank sync, workflow automations, vendor payments, budgeting, phone/Zoom support, property listings, user role controls.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $239/month billed monthly or $209/month billed annually (~13% off). Unlimited units. Adds VIP priority support, free ACH payments, free property websites, Zapier integration, unlimited eSignatures, unlimited users, unlimited storage, affordable housing reporting.

limits: Portfolios over 300 units require custom demo quote
Per-unit overage applies above included units
keyFeatures: AI-assisted property management on Pro+
Full accounting with bank sync and QuickBooks
Affordable housing reporting on Premium
Free property websites on Premium
enrichment.provenance: Prices fetched from doorloop.com/pricing on 2026-06-15; annual discounts verified by computing monthly-vs-annual list prices.

vendors.name: RentRedi
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched from rentredi.com/pricing on 2026-06-15. All plans cover unlimited units; pricing is per account, not per property. Start $5/mo, Grow $29.95/mo (or $12/mo annual), Pro is custom (contact required).

plans.name: Start
plans.notes: $5/month, unlimited units and tenants. Includes online rent collection (ACH, card, cash), AutoPay, late fees, tenant portal, credit reporting, in-app chat, 24/7 support. No leasing or screening tools.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: $29.95/month (monthly) or $12/month billed annually (~60% savings). Unlimited units. Adds property listings, one-click syndication, custom website, e-signatures, document storage, maintenance requests, vendor management, income/expense tracking, financial reports, tenant screening ($39.99–$49.99 tenant-paid), priority phone support.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact required ('Call Us' on the page). All Grow features plus dedicated account manager and elite priority support. Designed for professional landlords and growing portfolios.

limits: No unit caps — all plans cover unlimited properties
No free tier (lowest paid plan is $5/mo)
keyFeatures: Unlimited units on all plans including $5/month entry tier
Significant annual discount (60%) on Grow plan
Built-in credit reporting for tenants
Mobile-first landlord and tenant apps
bestFor: small landlords wanting low monthly cost
DIY landlords managing unlimited units affordably
enrichment.provenance: Prices fetched from rentredi.com/pricing on 2026-06-15; 30-day money-back guarantee and unlimited-units confirmed.

vendors.name: TurboTenant
vendors.provenance: TurboTenant's pricing page returns HTTP 403. Free-forever tier and Premium $149/yr ($12.42/mo) entry price corroborated via TurboTenant's official Premium page, the Premium announcement blog, and the support center. Note: Premium now scales with unit count — Essentials tier $149–$349/yr and Pro tier $199–$999/yr per portfolio size — so $12.42/mo is the published starting (floor) price, not a universal flat rate. Capterra still lists a legacy flat $12.42 Premium (and a defunct $9.92 'Pro'); treated as lagging aggregator.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever, unlimited units. Includes property listings syndicated to many rental sites, tenant screening (tenant-paid), rent collection, maintenance requests, lease management, in-app messaging. Tenants pay ACH and card processing fees.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Starting at $149/year billed annually ($12.42/month equivalent) for the base Essentials tier; no month-to-month option. Premium now scales by unit count: Essentials $149–$349/yr, Pro $199–$999/yr depending on portfolio size. Adds income verification, unlimited e-signatures, eviction assistance, waived ACH fees, advanced reporting, priority support.

limits: Premium price scales with number of units ($149–$349/yr Essentials, $199–$999/yr Pro)
Tenant screening fees are tenant-paid on free plan
keyFeatures: Generous free-forever tier with full feature access
Low-cost paid tier starting at $149/year
Listings syndicated to many rental sites
Eviction assistance included in Premium
bestFor: first-time landlords wanting no upfront cost
enrichment.provenance: Pricing page returned 403; free tier and $149/yr Premium floor confirmed via official Premium/announcement pages and support center on 2026-06-15. Premium is unit-tiered, not flat.

vendors.name: Avail
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched from avail.com/pricing on 2026-06-15. Avail offers two plans: a free Unlimited tier ($0/unit) and a paid Unlimited Plus at $9/unit/month; no flat-fee option exists.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: Free forever, unlimited units. Listings on multiple platforms, rental applications, tenant screening (tenant-paid), state-specific lease templates, online rent collection, maintenance tracking, income/expense tracking. Tenants pay $2.50 per ACH transfer; 3.5% card fee always applies.

plans.name: Unlimited Plus
plans.notes: $9/unit/month. Adds FastPay (next-day rent deposits), waived ACH fees for tenants, custom lease templates with cloning, custom application questions, branded property website, priority support. 3.5% card fee still applies.

limits: Unlimited Plus scales with unit count ($9 per unit)
ACH fee $2.50/transfer for tenants on free plan
3.5% card processing fee always charged to tenants
keyFeatures: Free tier with state-specific lease templates
FastPay next-day deposits on Plus tier
Backed by Realtor.com parent (Move, Inc.)
Tenant portal with online applications and screening

vendors.name: Hemlane

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Free forever, no credit card required. Listings on Apartments.com, Zillow, and more sites; applicant screening; full rental accounting with bank sync. No rent collection or lease management.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $28 base fee + $2/unit/month (shown as $30/month for one unit). Annual billing saves up to 20%. Adds lease tracking, document storage with e-sign, online rent collection, $0 ACH fees, private messaging, tenant perks.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: $28 base fee + $20/unit/month (shown as $48/month for one unit). Annual billing saves up to 20%. Adds 24/7 emergency repair coordination, automatic maintenance diagnosis, work order management, state-specific leases.

plans.name: Complete
plans.notes: $28 base fee + $58/unit/month (shown as $86/month for one unit). Annual billing saves up to 20%. Adds property management assistant, vetted repair network, VIP support, leasing and turnover coordination network.
